title: DeepSeek Cold Atom Scan Report 2026-08-09

canonical_node.axiom: The canonical atom ledger must be reconciled to the 2026-08-09 canonical revision; any atom not updated after that date is suspect for drift.
definitions: Canonical revision: the 2026-08-09 document that fixes the Master Equation, four axioms, three levels, and ten laws.
Atom: a ledger entry with an ID and status; must contain full claim text to be canonically safe.
Drift: any atom that conflicts with the canonical revision, e.g., a fifth axiom, bits/s in all nine factors, or old spine numbering.
ORPHANED: an atom with no physics-side anchor, reclassified from active_candidate_unanchored.
derivation: The ledger contains 268 atoms, but only 2 are in the master-equation namespace.
198 atoms are NOT_ESTABLISHED, 44 are ISOMORPHIC_EVENT_CANDIDATE, 10 are BRIDGE_DECLARED.
The sample atom tp:ME/L5/C1 is not in the ledger, indicating a ledger integrity failure.
Many sections (Level 0, gradient dynamics, Ten Laws, conservation results, retired claims, Numbers-in-God) have no covering atoms.
Therefore, the ledger is an unverified scaffold, not a canonical atom base.
canonical_node.action: Reconcile the ledger to the 2026-08-09 canonical revision; add missing load-bearing atoms; add or retire the sample atom; reclassify unanchored atoms as ORPHANED; quarantine python-colab-runtime-lane; re-run audit after each law and spiritual family has a typed atom with kill condition.
boundary: This document does not establish any new physics or theology; it is an audit of ledger completeness.
It does not claim that any atom is canonically safe; it only identifies gaps and drifts.
It does not provide full claim text for atoms; mapping is ID-inferred.
test: Check that every 7 law and 8 spiritual family has a typed atom with a kill condition.
Verify that no atom asserts a fifth axiom, bits/s in all nine factors, or old spine numbering.
Confirm that all active_candidate_unanchored atoms are reclassified as ORPHANED.
Ensure the sample atom tp:ME/L5/C1 is either added to the ledger or formally retired.

dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Provides a structural integrity audit that identifies ledger gaps and drifts, enabling prioritization of atom writing and reclassification.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves the canonical revision's claims and boundaries, including the four-axiom canon, bits/s only in Level 0, and the honest boundary of non-claims.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: Without this audit, the ledger would remain incomplete and unverified, risking drift and resurrection of retired claims.
dg5_translation_registers: Atom ID to canonical claim mapping (ID-inferred)

classification.recommended_atom_action: Use as a gap analysis and priority list; do not treat as a canonical atom itself.

overstatement_risks: Treating the audit's ID-inferred mappings as verified claim text.
Assuming the audit's priority list is exhaustive or that the canonical revision is final.
Using the audit's verdict to claim the canon is dishonest.
kill_conditions: If the canonical revision is superseded, the audit's findings become stale.
If the ledger is fully reconciled, the audit's gap list becomes obsolete.
If any atom is added without full claim text, the ledger remains unsafe.
risk.lean_target: No Lean target; this is a ledger integrity audit.

plain_summary: This document is an audit of a 268-atom ledger against a canonical revision. It finds the ledger incomplete and unverified, with only two master-equation atoms and many gaps. It recommends reconciliation, adding missing atoms, reclassifying unanchored atoms, and re-running the audit. It does not establish new claims.
